description: NaLaCP₂H₄O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.46 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.75 Å. La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.70 Å. C is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two P and two H atoms. There is one shorter (1.81 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) C-P bond length. Both C-H bond lengths are 1.10 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form corner-sharing PCO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form corner-sharing PCO₃ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one P atom.
